Title: LR2 - ED-330 - CA track classification and prioritisation schema
Text: The DAA shall use the following schema to classify the tracks for CA alerting and guidance: - Filtering based on range: Relative horizontal range <= 1.2 NM and absolute vertical distance <= 670 ft (see appendix C, paragraph 4.2); - Filtering based on Tau Mod value: Priority is given to lower Tau Mod value
